median_method: Non-detects (ResultDetectionConditionText 'Not Detected' or 'Detected Not Quantified', no numeric value) were kept as left-censored at their own reporting limit and substituted with half the limit; the median was computed on detects plus these. Because the median lies far above nearly all limits, 0 / DL / DL/2 substitution gives the same median to within rounding (early 1.9-2.0, late 3.3). Detected values below the limit (flagged estimated) kept as reported.
notes: Filter: USGSPCode 01000, dissolved, ActivityTypeCode Sample-Routine (field replicates/QC excluded), media subdivision Groundwater (excludes elutriation/soil moisture/interstitial/leachate), years 2000-2023; each result one observation. Reporting limits are those of censored results (3 'Detected Not Quantified' with no value: limits 1.8-1.9). Limits fell from about 1-5 ug/L early (max 5.0) to about 0.1 late, with a few 11.4-20 outliers. Early: no non-detect has a limit >10, so share >10 is exact. Late: 5 non-detects have limits of 11-20 ug/L so their status vs 10 is unknown; share is 30.8% (lower bound) to 31.2% (upper bound), reported as lower bound. Medians differ but sampled wells/networks differ between periods, so this is not evidence of change at individual wells.
